dogecoin.text:
$DOGE total supply increased by 152% in the last years. 
$BTC supply increased by 50%. 

The recent spike experienced by DOGE, reaching the same price in BTC terms as in 2014 shows that $BTC is definitely undervalued.

Dogecoin $DOGE reaching the same price it had back in 2014 in $BTC terms shows that #Bitcoin is definitely undervalued. 

In 2014, DOGE had a supply of 50.8 billion and BTC had a supply of 12.40 million. 

Now, DOGE has a supply of 128 billion and BTC a supply of 18.64 million. https://t.co/BOsvoerQ5I
